summary_hint: Employer-completed VOE for <employee> at <employer>: <status> since <start date>, <position>, base pay <amount>/<period>, continued employment <probability>. — the headline a processor needs without opening the form.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity: who prepared/originated the VOE form; third-party-independence check.

typed_core.name: document_issue_date
typed_core.why: CL-4 (final-VOE window test); document recency.

typed_core.name: employer_name
typed_core.why: IN-8 (VOE must be tied to the employer, else fire); identity. Flattened from employer_name_and_address.

typed_core.name: employer_address
typed_core.why: processor: employer match/reconciliation; disambiguates employer_name. Flattened from employer_name_and_address.

typed_core.name: lender_name
typed_core.why: third-party independence (VOE goes to lender, not borrower); identity. Flattened from lender_name_and_address.

typed_core.name: applicant_name
typed_core.why: identity: whose employment is verified; borrower match. Flattened from applicant_name_address_and_employee_number.

typed_core.name: applicant_address
typed_core.why: PII (borrower home address — otherwise stored raw in the catch-all). Flattened.

typed_core.name: employee_number
typed_core.why: identifier: ties the VOE to the employee record; potential PII (may be an SSN). Flattened.

typed_core.name: employment_status
typed_core.why: disambiguator: distinguishes the present- vs previous-employment blocks so IN-4 can order records.
typed_core.prompt_hint: A VOE has a present-employment and a previous-employment section — extract dates/positions into the matching previous_* fields; do not collapse them.

typed_core.name: employment_start_date
typed_core.why: IN-4 (order employment records, compute gaps).

typed_core.name: present_position
typed_core.why: IN-7 (same line of work / income stability).

typed_core.name: probability_of_continued_employment
typed_core.why: IN-7 / income-stability context; processor.

typed_core.name: current_gross_base_pay
typed_core.why: processor: base income; income-stability context.

typed_core.name: base_pay_period
typed_core.why: disambiguator for current_gross_base_pay (annual vs monthly vs hourly).
typed_core.prompt_hint: Money may carry '$'/commas; report the period exactly as printed.

typed_core.name: average_hours_per_week
typed_core.why: disambiguator: needed to annualize hourly base pay; processor.

typed_core.name: previous_employment_hire_date
typed_core.why: IN-4 (order records, compute gaps between jobs).

typed_core.name: previous_employment_termination_date
typed_core.why: IN-4 (order records, compute gaps between jobs).

typed_core.name: position_held
typed_core.why: IN-7 (prior role — the other half of the same-line-of-work comparison).

typed_core.name: employer_signer_name
typed_core.why: identity: who certified the VOE; third-party independence.

typed_core.name: employer_signer_title
typed_core.why: third-party independence (authorized signer of the employer).

typed_core.name: employer_signer_phone
typed_core.why: processor: re-verification callback.

typed_core.name: employer_signature_and_date
typed_core.why: CL-4 (certification date must fall in the window).

typed_core.name: direct_return_to_lender_indicator
typed_core.why: processor / independence (VOE not handled by the borrower).
typed_core.prompt_hint: The 'returned directly to lender' checkbox — an independence signal; report the checkbox state as text.

typed_core.name: applicant_authorization_signature
typed_core.why: processor: borrower authorized the verification.

typed_core.name: ytd_income
typed_core.why: processor: YTD earnings supports base-pay reasonableness / income trend.

nested_lists.name: gross_earnings_history
nested_lists.shape_reason: few rows (typically current + 2 prior years, columns base/overtime/commission/bonus), well under the 16,384 ceiling → flat is cheapest.

fields.name: period
fields.why: IN-7 — the year/period label the earnings row belongs to

fields.name: base
fields.why: IN-7 — base earnings for the period (variable-income stability)

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: VOE forms are not a single standardized form; classification handles type

rejected.name: issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: issuer ≈ employer; employer/signer contact already captured

rejected.name: effective_date, expiration_date, statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: a VOE has no coverage period; duplicate document_issue_date

rejected.name: property_address, loan_number
rejected.reason: not on a VOE; linkage flows through the applicant

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: VOE is not notarized; signer captured individually

rejected.name: lender_signature_title_date, lender_number
rejected.reason: lender does not certify the facts; no consumer

rejected.name: military_pay_components
rejected.reason: rare; one-list budget spent on gross_earnings_history

rejected.name: overtime_continuance_likely, bonus_continuance_likely
rejected.reason: booleans / near-judgments; income stability covered by probability_of_continued_employment + earnings history

rejected.name: salary_at_termination
rejected.reason: no rule; income analysis uses current pay

rejected.name: reason_for_leaving
rejected.reason: no rule; LOE conditioning is manual

encoding_variations: Base pay period: stated as '/yr', 'annual', 'per month', '$/hr' — base_pay_period must travel beside current_gross_base_pay, and average_hours_per_week beside an hourly rate, or the pay is annualized wrong.

Present vs previous employment: the same fields (position, dates, salary) appear twice on the form; employment_status and the previous_* field names disambiguate which block a value came from for IN-4.
Continuation probability: 'likely', 'yes', 'probable', 'good' — kept as free str, not an enum.
Certification date: the 'final VOE' date can appear as the form's issue date or beside the employer signature; both captured (document_issue_date, employer_signature_and_date).

open_questions.q: gross_earnings_history shape. Item count is small and stable (~3 year-rows).
military_pay_components. Separate nested list vs drop. Rare outside VA files; the one-list budget is spent on earnings history.
options: drop now, revisit for VA-heavy pipelines
open_questions.recommendation: drop now, revisit for VA-heavy pipelines.

options: treat as raw PII and confirm masking policy
open_questions.recommendation: treat as raw PII and confirm masking policy with Priya before go-live.

open_questions.q: employment_status is absent from the catalog. It is a derived disambiguator IN-4 relies on to order present vs previous blocks.
CL-4 is out of scope but which date is 'the final VOE date' — document_issue_date or employer_signature_and_date?
open_questions.recommendation: employer_signature_and_date (the certification date) as the window anchor.

notes: PII: applicant_address needs _PII_FIELDS registration (pre_masked false; would otherwise land raw in the catch-all). employee_number needs registration (pre_masked false) and may be an SSN on some forms — confirm masking with Priya. applicant_name and employer_signer_name are standard-sensitivity names, acceptable as typed core, not registered.
Do not judge income stability or gaps — report dates and positions verbatim; IN-4/IN-7 judge.
Ambiguity: employee_number — reason_class pii but the PII kind is uncertain (employee-record identifier that may be an SSN); registered kind 'ACCOUNT', pre_masked false, pending confirmation.
Ambiguity: employer_signer_title is a third-party-independence field tagged neither test explicitly; classified processor.
